messages.author: 4072426cef17b1f2
messages.subject: Optimx parameter restrictions
parts:
Hi,

I'm optimizing a function using optimx (a more streamlined version of optim), and the parameters I'm optimizing are a series of temperatures. Specifically they are the temperatures that control how much 'thermal time' a plant accumulates towards a development stage at a particular temperature. Because of this I need the first parameter to be smaller than the second which is smaller than the third, and so on. Is there any way to do this? I tried writing the function so that if a parameter was too big or too small, the function would return an error. However this gave me NAs for the parameter values where the temperatures would have been switched.

Thanks!
Elise

messages.author: d567d0ef3c054a35
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Optimx parameter restrictions
parts:
I think that's a reasonable idea. I've appended a tiny chunk of code
that expands on the idea.

-- Mike

> foo
function(aa, bb, cc) {
argNames = ls( )
myArgs = sapply(argNames, function(x) get(x))
names(myArgs) = argNames
isTRUE(all.equal(myArgs, sort(myArgs)))
}
> foo(3, 5, 8)
[1] TRUE
> foo(8, 3, 5)
[1] FALSE

>
